mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO fund_nav ( id, fund_code, nav_date, unit_nav, accumulated_nav, daily_growth_rate, source, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.fundCode}, #{item.navDate}, #{item.unitNav}, #{item.accumulatedNav}, #{item.dailyGrowthRate}, #{item.source}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
ON CONFLICT (fund_code, nav_date) DO UPDATE SET unit_nav = EXCLUDED.unit_nav, accumulated_nav = EXCLUDED.accumulated_nav, daily_growth_rate = EXCLUDED.daily_growth_rate, source = CASE WHEN fund_nav.source = 'AKSHARE_ALL' OR EXCLUDED.source = 'AKSHARE_ALL' THEN 'AKSHARE_ALL' WHEN fund_nav.source LIKE 'AKSHARE_DAYS_%' AND EXCLUDED.source LIKE 'AKSHARE_DAYS_%' THEN 'AKSHARE_DAYS_' || GREATEST( CAST(SUBSTRING(fund_nav.source FROM 14) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTRING(EXCLUDED.source FROM 14) AS INTEGER) ) ELSE EXCLUDED.source END, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT nav_date AS date, unit_nav, accumulated_nav, daily_growth_rate FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} ORDER BY nav_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(MAX( CASE WHEN source = 'AKSHARE_ALL' THEN 5000 WHEN source LIKE 'AKSHARE_DAYS_%' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(source FROM 14) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM fund_nav WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode}
